profiles.name: Generic Agent Plugin
profiles.summary: Portable Agent Plugins v1 floor: Agent Skills plus MCP, without host lifecycle guarantees.

capabilities.notes: A client may expose a vault directory; the plugin format does not own it.
The v1 package format defines stdio and Streamable HTTP configuration.
Skills are discovered from the fixed skills/ directory.
Hooks are outside the Agent Plugins v1 core contract.
Session events are client-specific.
Scheduling is client-owned, not portable plugin behavior.
Prompt UX is defined by the host client.
This descriptor describes the v1 package contract itself.

limitations: The package format does not define hooks, commands, agents, UI, permissions, or updates.

profiles.name: BB
profiles.summary: Dex's internal build/batch harness; portable core and skills are supported, while host lifecycle details remain internal.

capabilities.notes: Runs against a local Dex vault.
Can launch Dex MCP servers from the repository.
Uses the generated .agents skill surface where available.
Internal lifecycle behavior is not a public portability promise.
Session behavior depends on the BB runner.
Fleet jobs may run outside a chat turn.
The runner supplies a prompt channel.
No public BB plugin loader contract is claimed.

limitations: BB is an internal harness label, not a public client compatibility guarantee.

profiles.name: ChatGPT Work companion
profiles.summary: A ChatGPT Work companion can provide a conversational front end, but local Dex vault and plugin loading are not assumed.

capabilities.notes: A local vault bridge must be explicitly supplied by the companion.
ChatGPT Work connectors are not the same as a local MCP client.
No local Agent Skills loader is assumed.
No Dex hook lifecycle is exposed by this descriptor.
Lifecycle is controlled by the ChatGPT product.
Dex cannot promise a local scheduler here.
Conversation prompts are host-native.
Do not install a local plugin unless the client explicitly supports Agent Plugins v1.

limitations: This descriptor intentionally avoids promising local filesystem, MCP, or plugin parity.

profiles.name: Claude Code
profiles.summary: Dex's Tier 3 reference harness with native skills, MCP, hooks, and session lifecycle support.

capabilities.notes: Local filesystem access is available in the active project.
Project and user MCP configuration are supported.
Canonical .claude/skills are loaded by Claude Code.
PreToolUse, prompt-submit, session, and post-tool hooks are available.
SessionStart and SessionEnd surfaces are available.
Dex's OS-scheduled jobs are independent of the chat harness.
AskUserQuestion is available when the client provides it.
The portable Agent Plugins package remains the compatibility floor.

limitations: Claude-only hooks are not copied into harness-neutral adapters.

profiles.name: Codex
profiles.summary: MCP-capable coding harness with AGENTS.md and generated Agent Skills, without Claude hook semantics.

capabilities.notes: The active workspace is available to the agent.
MCP servers can be registered by the host.
AGENTS.md and the generated .agents/skills surface are portable.
Claude settings hooks are not assumed.
Codex lifecycle behavior is host-defined, not Dex hook-compatible.
Dex does not assume a Codex scheduler.
Conversation input is host-native.
Use the generic Agent Plugin package only when the client advertises v1 support.

limitations: No Claude-only hook parity is claimed.

profiles.name: GitHub Copilot CLI
profiles.summary: CLI harness with local files, MCP, and portable instructions; lifecycle and scheduling remain host-owned.

capabilities.notes: The current working directory is available to the CLI.
Copilot CLI can use configured MCP servers.
Use the Agent Skills surface when the installed CLI version advertises it.
Claude hooks are not portable to Copilot CLI.
Lifecycle events are client-defined.
No Dex scheduler contract is assumed.
CLI interaction is host-native.
Install the generic package only after checking client support.

limitations: The descriptor is intentionally version-neutral where Copilot CLI behavior changes by release.

profiles.name: Claude Cowork
profiles.summary: Desktop Cowork companion with skills and interactive work; local hooks and scheduling are not assumed.

capabilities.notes: Folder access depends on the desktop permission granted by the user.
MCP availability is product/version dependent; verify before promising a server.
Portable skills can be supplied when the Cowork build supports Agent Skills.
Claude Code settings hooks are not assumed in Cowork.
The desktop session lifecycle is client-owned.
Dex's local scheduler is not provided by Cowork.
Desktop conversation prompts are host-native.
Use Agent Plugins v1 only if the installed client advertises it.

limitations: Cowork is not treated as Claude Code; hooks and settings.json are not portable assumptions.

profiles.name: Pi
profiles.summary: Local coding agent with workspace files, Agent Skills, and lifecycle events, but no built-in Dex MCP or scheduler promise.

capabilities.notes: The workspace is available to Pi extensions and skills.
Pi does not provide a built-in MCP client in this descriptor; use an explicit bridge.
AGENTS.md and Agent Skills are the portable instruction surface.
Pi events are not the Claude hook contract.
Pi extensions can observe lifecycle events.
No Dex scheduler is assumed.
Pi exposes interactive conversation input.
Install only if the Pi host adds an Agent Plugins loader.

limitations: MCP and scheduling require a separately installed bridge or host integration.
